claim_one_line: THE LITERATURE PASS: FIVE SOURCES READ AT SOURCE, ONE DEFECT FOUND IN THIS SEAT'S OWN WORK, TWO SOURCES STILL UNREACHABLE, AND -- STATED PLAINLY BECAUSE THE SEAL REQUIRED IT -- NO NEW INSIGHT. PREREGISTRATION sealed 9880dc0189734102 and PUSHED at 700a4ae BEFORE ANY SOURCE WAS OPENED, with a prediction per target and three binding kill conditions, one of which was the standing risk that a sweep gets reported as productive when it only confirmed things. NO PAPER FOUND HERE CHANGES HOW WE SEE THE OBJECT, THE FAMILY, OR THEIR ROOTS, AND THAT IS THE HEADLINE. T3, NEUMANN-REID READ AT SOURCE: Theorem 2.4 (k_Delta = k(Gamma)) is stated for a CUSPED M and defines k_Delta as generated by ALL n tetrahedral parameters -- and xB022 V4's instrument computed the minimal polynomial of z_1 ALONE, a possible proper subfield, so the 40-word comparison was of the wrong object. Recomputed with a primitive element over all shapes: 0 of 72 determined words differ, A5 leaves k_Delta unchanged 72 of 72, so xB022 V4's INSTRUMENT was wrong and its CONCLUSION was right anyway -- both halves reported. A SECOND GUARD HAD TO BE ADDED MID-CELL: the first run reported one difference, a degree-12 polynomial with 10^18-scale coefficients confirmed at only 80 digits when a spurious algdep relation of that degree and height needs about 216, which is precisely this session's E56 shape; a height guard (dps > 2 d log10 H) was added, the difference vanished, and 42 of 114 words are now reported UNDETERMINED rather than counted either way. Consequence: xB022 V4's fence on the invariant trace field is RETIRED for the cusped corpus. T4, WITTEN READ AT SOURCE: eq. 2.2 verbatim, I = -s Im W + l Re W with s in C and l in Z, the level forced integral by the mod-2pi indeterminacy of Re W -- STRONGER than the record's phrasing. T5, GUKOV READ AT SOURCE: section 1.1 verbatim, k in Z and 's is not quantized, however s must obey certain constraints imposed by unitarity' -- a REFINEMENT the record does not carry, since the record says 'free continuous parameter'; xB016's closure is unaffected because it needs only that nothing couples sigma to k. T1, CGHN: FIRST GRADED UNREACHABLE AND THAT GRADE WAS THIS SEAT'S ERROR -- SEE ADDENDUM 1. The paper was freely available throughout, on Project Euclid's open archive and as snappaper3.pdf on Neumann's own Columbia page, the same page that had already supplied Neumann-Reid; the first attempt failed only because WebFetch could not parse the PDF binary, and that was read as 'no access' rather than 'wrong tool'. OBTAINED AND READ AT SOURCE: B1239's TWO quotations are EXACT and correctly attributed (section 5A's mod-1/2 statement, section 5B's 3 eta = 2 cs + tau (mod 2) with tau the number of 2-primary summands of H_1, credited to Atiyah-Patodi-Singer 1975), so T1's sealed prediction is CONFIRMED. CGHN also states what Meyerhoff-Ouyang actually does -- it extends eta to cusped M 'for which one has chosen a basis of homology at each cusp' -- confirming L194's long-standing guess at a cusp-basis correction, graded SECONDARY since MO itself is STILL UNREAD and STILL cited for nothing. Combining CGHN 5B with Kawauchi I+III (xB023) closes the chain in the CLOSED case: a closed hyperbolic 3-manifold with a FREE orientation-reversing involution has cs = 0 MOD 1, not merely mod 1/2, with the one unsourced link (eta is odd under orientation reversal) NAMED. C1 measured the Kawauchi half at 46 of 46 tau even; THE CS HALF IS UNTESTED because SnapPy cannot compute cs for these manifolds at all, which CGHN 5B itself predicts (Snap bootstraps along drilling/filling chains), AND AN EARLIER VERSION OF THAT CELL PASSED VACUOUSLY on 'zero + errors == total' -- a condition that passes when every measurement fails, this record's own test-vacuity class, caught and removed. CONSEQUENCE: this arc's banked 'NO new insight' headline stands for the six targets it covered and NOT for T1. T2, MEYERHOFF-OUYANG: UNREACHABLE confirmed as predicted, with two new unread leads named (Ouyang Topology 36 (1997) 411-421; Yoshida Invent. Math. 81 (1985) 473-514). T6, FLOYD-HATCHER and GUERITAUD: located, graded CITED, not read at source, no correction and no insight. T7, MINSKY: left to B1404 deliberately. Claims no novelty from an absence. Does not close L194. Supplies no value. Gate 5 absolute; nothing to CLAIMS.md. ADDENDUM 2: W. D. Neumann's 'Combinatorics of Triangulations and the Chern-Simons Invariant for Hyperbolic 3-Manifolds' (Topology '90, 243-271) READ AT SOURCE -- the paper Snap/SnapPy's CS formula comes from, so every CS number in this record rests on it and nobody here had opened it. Section 1 verbatim: compact M has CS well-defined modulo 2 pi^2, non-compact M has CS well-defined modulo pi^2 (due to Meyerhoff), and V(M) = Vol(M) + i CS(M). With CGHN 5A's 'cs(M) = (1/2 pi^2) CS(M)', L223's LITERATURE HALF CLOSES: the record's statement of Neumann's normalisation is EXACTLY RIGHT, read at source from both ends, and what remains in L223 is record-internal bookkeeping (which normalisation enters B1012's k-coupling) that was never a literature question. Neumann's Theorem 2 carries a conjectural SIX-FOLD ambiguity in its constant while xB015 found a Z/12 index; this is RECORDED AS A QUESTION AND EXPLICITLY NOT AN IDENTIFICATION, since matching small integers arising in different places with no map exhibited is this record's most-repeated error class. MEYERHOFF-OUYANG REMAINS UNREAD AND IS NOW PRICED, with six routes named and failed (Cambridge paywall, absent from arXiv, no eta paper on Neumann's page, EuDML interface unfetchable, Springer paywall on the companion Meyerhoff-Neumann Comment. Math. Helv. 67:1 (1992) 28-46) and the EMPIRICAL SUBSTITUTE CLOSED TOO -- SnapPy exposes only chern_simons and has no eta accessor, eta living in Snap, the separate PARI program. Completing Addendum 1's lesson from the other side: a grade of UNREAD is reportable only WITH THE ROUTES NAMED. L194 is unchanged and still open, its blocker now priced precisely.
